meaning:
ἐν-δοξάζω
[in LXX for כָּבַד ni., Exo.14:4, 17-18, Eze.28:22, etc.; for עָרַץ, Psa.89:7; Sir.38:6, al. ;]
to glorify: pass., 2Th.1:10-12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
